Admin routes of the analytics module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/analytics/customers

Get customer acquisition and retention metrics

Parameters:

- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/analytics/dashboard

Get overview dashboard metrics for today, week and month

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/analytics/funnel

Get conversion funnel counts and drop-off rates

Parameters:

- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: array of object.

## GET /v1/admin/analytics/pixels

Get tracking pixel configuration

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## PATCH /v1/admin/analytics/pixels

Update tracking pixel configuration

Request body: [UpdatePixelsAdminDto](#updatepixelsadmindto).

- `200`: no description.

## Schemas

### UpdatePixelsAdminDto

- `googleAnalyticsId` (string, pattern `/^[A-Za-z0-9\-]*$/`, max length 50, optional).
- `metaPixelId` (string, pattern `/^[0-9]*$/`, max length 50, optional).
- `tiktokPixelId` (string, pattern `/^[A-Za-z0-9]*$/`, max length 50, optional).
- `snapPixelId` (string, pattern `/^[A-Za-z0-9\-]*$/`, max length 50, optional).
